boundaries.comparison: actual joint states and actual motor outputs; targets recorded separately
hard_stop_on: applied torque outside compiled motor force range

notes: Speed is evaluated jointly with modeled voltage/current/torque; no-load speed is not a hard speed cap.
Soft-limit proximity and saturation are recorded, not silently promoted to hardware ratings.
Actual joint positions are checked; wide servo position targets are separately recorded.
32 float32 epsilons at the value scale are numerical tolerance only.

episode_result.physics_state_source: direct current qpos/qvel using named-joint address mapping

trial.goal: 60-second dual-ball retention without external force; translation allowed
trial.measurement_convention: 50-Hz original pre-forward geometric gate; run duration = sample count x 0.02s; drift is descriptive, not a position-return acceptance

pc_profile.note: Explicit CUDA synchronization added after each integrator call for attribution; profiler overhead changes timing. Control excludes policy and network; components are nested, not additive with control.

methods_not_applied.TensorRT_FP16: No provider/graph compatibility or speed evidence for this small recurrent policy yet
methods_not_applied.pruning: No silent weight deletion or fine-tuning; sparse-kernel benefit requires separate validation

policy_benchmark.selection_rule: same-model parity, at least 5% lower p95 and lower mean in this benchmark

recommendation.measurement_scope: One bounded run of each named variant, recorded observations, no live plant
recommendation.next_required: Review measured report; real full-loop timing remains unverified
